# Synthetic, in the shape of `ghostty +list-keybinds --plain` at v1.4.0: Config.zig `Keybinds.formatEntryDocs`,
# Binding.zig `Set.Value.formatEntries` and `Trigger.format` (W3C key names, `chain=`, `<table>/`).

keybind = ctrl+shift+v=paste_from_clipboard
keybind = super+ctrl+alt+shift+key_a=select_all

keybind = ctrl+shift+arrow_up=jump_to_prompt:-1
keybind = shift+page_up=scroll_page_up
keybind = ctrl+bracket_left=previous_tab
keybind = ctrl++=increase_font_size:1
keybind = ctrl+==increase_font_size:1
keybind = ctrl+shift+key_o=new_split:right
keybind = ctrl+a>n=new_window
keybind = ctrl+a>c=new_tab
keybind = alt+arrow_left=goto_split:left
keybind = chain=toggle_fullscreen
keybind = ctrl+key_q=quit
keybind = f11=toggle_fullscreen

keybind = ctrl+/=text:\x15
keybind = catch_all=ignore
keybind = ctrl+ö=reset
